segments.ja415:1.1: Na kiratthi anomadassisu, pāricariyā buddhesu appikā [appakā (ka.)];
segments.ja415:2.1: Hatthigavassā cime bahū [hatthigavāssā ca me bahū (sī.), hatthī gavāssā cime bahū (syā.), hatthī gavāssā ca me bahū (pī.)], dhanadhaññaṃ pathavī ca kevalā;
segments.ja415:3.3: Pucchāmi taṃ raṭṭhavaḍḍhana, bāḷhaṃ pītimano pabhāsasi.
segments.ja415:6.3: Adaṃ buddhāna kummāsaṃ, pasanno sehi pāṇibhi.
segments.ja415:7.1: Tassa kammassa kusalassa, idaṃ me edisaṃ phalaṃ;
segments.ja415:8.1: Dadaṃ bhuñja mā ca pamādo [dada bhuñja ca mā ca pamādo (sī. pī.)], cakkaṃ vattaya kosalādhipa;
segments.ja415:8.3: Mā rāja adhammiko ahu, dhammaṃ pālaya kosalādhipa.
segments.ja415:9.1: Sohaṃ tadeva punappunaṃ, vaṭumaṃ ācarissāmi sobhane;
segments.ja415:9.3: Ariyācaritaṃ sukosale, arahanto me manāpāva passituṃ.
segments.ja415:10.1: Devī viya accharūpamā, majjhe nārigaṇassa sobhasi;
segments.ja415:10.3: Kiṃ kammamakāsi bhaddakaṃ, kenāsi vaṇṇavatī sukosale.
segments.ja415:11.3: Saññatā ca [saññatā (sī. pī.)] dhammajīvinī, sīlavatī ca apāpadassanā.
segments.ja415:12.1: Uddhaṭabhattaṃ ahaṃ tadā, caramānassa adāsi bhikkhuno;
segments.ja415:12.3: Vittā sumanā sayaṃ ahaṃ, tassa kammassa phalaṃ mamedisanti.
